meta.name: ingest
meta.description: Fetch requested source material and prepare sourced engagement updates. Use to catch up from external notes or messages; applying updates requires a bound record and confirmation.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 抓取外部笔记或消息,整理成可引用的进展更新
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要从零散的笔记和消息里追赶最新进展
copy.tagline_en: Pull notes and messages into ready-to-cite progress updates
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to catch up from scattered notes and messages

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会按你的要求抓取来源材料,整理出带出处的更新草稿,做草稿不需要先绑定记录。要把更新正式写入,则需要已绑定的记录,并得到你的确认。
howto.when: 当你需要从外部笔记或消息里补上进展、整理带出处的更新时触发;若由 @fde 调用,则复用其现有的脱敏信息包和范围,不重开已答过的设置与提问。

say.text: 从我给你的这份会议笔记里整理出带出处的更新草稿
say.note: 只产出草稿,不写入已绑定记录

say.text: 把这些消息要点整理成带出处的更新草稿
say.note: 每条要点保留来源出处

say.text: 确认无误,把这份更新应用到已绑定记录里
say.note: 需已绑定记录,应用前会再确认

howto.what_en: Claude fetches the source material you request and prepares a sourced engagement update draft; producing a draft does not require an engagement record. Applying the update requires a bound record and your confirmation.
howto.when_en: When you want to catch up from external notes or messages and prepare sourced updates. If called by @fde, it reuses that sanitized packet and scope instead of restarting setup or questions.

say_en.text: Prepare a sourced update draft from this meeting note
say_en.note: Draft only; not written to a bound record

say_en.text: Turn these message highlights into a sourced update draft
Apply this update to the bound record
say_en.note: Needs a bound record and confirmation
